description.en: Obtains a tactic with the "J_07" jingle presentation and a caller-specified message — a fixed-preset wrapper around RunGetItemEx (reusing the item-get flow for tactics).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Obtain a tactic with a specific message, as RunGetTactics does internally
RunGetTacticsUseMsg(_tcs, "sysmes-Tactics-00001");
